Section01explanation:
Hello! I am a front-end developer with 4 years and 7 months of experience in React/Next.js product development, CI/CD, E2E testing, and DevOps.

I have built real-world products including AI-based protein analysis (AD3), pathology image analysis (PATH), antibody-drug conjugate visualization (ADC), and smart factory monitoring systems. I've also led CI/CD automation, security/quality inspection, and Claude Code-based AI development workflows.
